other_conditions: Must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab and pay contributions regularly
Must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law
Must not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF), National Pension System (NPS) or Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)
Must not be an income tax payer
Must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Must have received training under the “Skill Upgradation” or “Recognition of Prior Learning” scheme of the Board
Purchased tools must be relevant to the applicant's profession
benefits_summary: Up to ₹5,000 reimbursement for tool purchase, available once every three years.
